name: LACY GTA VI Marathon (Reach, $12.5K pool)
visualRules: GTA 6 only: the shown footage must be GTA 6 gameplay. IRL footage (out and about, at events, in a car), other games and anything else that isn't GTA 6 breaks this rule.
Logos of any kind are not allowed: no console, app, store, brand, game-tile or radio-station logos, and no watermarks. GTA 6's own world (signs, cars, storefronts) is fine.
Lacy must be the primary focus: footage that is mostly someone else's stream or video doesn't count.
notes: Source: Lacy's GTA 6 marathon (from Nov 18, 2026). Lacy must be the primary focus of every clip: his reaction, his voice or his gameplay carries the moment, not chat, a guest or another streamer. Never portray Lacy in a negative light, never hate-farm, never imply drama or a false story; hooks must be positive or neutral and true to what happens. Only GTA 6 moments count: skip anything that isn't GTA 6 gameplay or Lacy reacting to it (IRL segments, other games, just chatting), however good it is. Good ones: first reactions to the game, chases, crashes, funny NPC moments, big laughs. English only. The hook and caption must name LACY.
